_comment: All rates in basis points (bps). 100 bps = 1%. Money in paise.
gst_source: GST law - 18% on payment aggregator service fees

tolerance._comment: Exception if delta exceeds max(Rs 1, 0.5% of expected fee)

guardrails._comment: Nothing here is a fee rule - these are the limits on what the agent is allowed to close by itself. CLAUDE.md section 10.
guardrails._min_confidence_note: Below this the agent goes to a human, whatever it said.
guardrails._review_above_note: Rs 250. Money at stake above this always gets a human, however confident.
